content:
Lean 4 running on Android

i got Lean 4 cross-compiled for aarch64-linux-android and running inside an Android app. as far as i can tell nobody had tried this, and I had to make a few changes since Lean upstream doesn't really support that target.

  • https://github.com/saviorand/lean4-android — the toolchain, plus a minimal APK that proves the runtime works

Additionally, tried making a Ui with Kotlin and Compose:

  • https://github.com/saviorand/lean-android-compose — a Compose app doing its computation in Lean over JNI
  • https://github.com/saviorand/lean-compose — a typed DSL for authoring Compose UI in Lean, inspired by @Paul Butcher 's lean-html

Have a couple ideas and fixes for the upstream lean repo issues/prs based on this, but not sure if the team is even interested in supporting Android as a target?
